lemmas.name: idxOf_filter_mono
lemmas.statement: ∀ (p : Int → Bool) (l : List Int) (x y : Int), p x = true → p y = true → l.idxOf x ≤ l.idxOf y → (l.filter p).idxOf x ≤ (l.filter p).idxOf y
lemmas.proof:
by intro p l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x y _ _ _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x y hx hy h
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      by_cases hpa : p a = true
      · simp [List.filter_cons, hpa]
      · exact absurd hx hpa
    · by_cases hay : a = y
      · subst hay
        have : (a :: t).idxOf a = 0 := List.idxOf_cons_self
        have h2 : (a :: t).idxOf x = (t.idxOf x) + 1 := by simp [List.idxOf_cons, hax]
        omega
      · have h1 : (a :: t).idxOf x = t.idxOf x + 1 := by simp [List.idxOf_cons, hax]
        have h2 : (a :: t).idxOf y = t.idxOf y + 1 := by simp [List.idxOf_cons, hay]
        have := ih x y hx hy (by omega)
        by_cases hpa : p a = true
        · simp [List.filter_cons, hpa, List.idxOf_cons, hax, hay]; omega
        · have hpa' : p a = false := by simpa using hpa
          simp [List.filter_cons, hpa']; exact this

lemmas.name: fen_exit
lemmas.statement: ∀ (arr result : Array Int) (h : findEvenNumbers_precond arr), result.toList = arr.toList.filter isEven → findEvenNumbers_postcond arr result h
lemmas.proof:
by intro arr result h hr
  unfold findEvenNumbers_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    rw [hr] at hx
    have he := (List.mem_filter.mp hx)
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨by simpa using he.2, he.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hr, List.count_filter]; simp [he.2]
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro hev
    rw [hr]; exact List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hev⟩
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro y hy
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro hx' hy' hle
    rw [hr]
    exact idxOf_filter_mono isEven arr.toList x y hx' hy' hle

lemmas.name: exit34
lemmas.statement: ∀ (arr acc : Array Int) (i : Nat) (h : findEvenNumbers_precond arr), (i ≤ arr.size ∧ acc.toList = (arr.toList.take i).filter isEven) → ¬ i < arr.size → findEvenNumbers_postcond arr acc h
lemmas.proof:
by intro arr acc i h hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hacc⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = arr.size := by omega
  subst hi'
  have ht : arr.toList.take arr.size = arr.toList := List.take_of_length_le (by simp)
  rw [ht] at hacc
  exact fen_exit arr acc h hacc
